title: Mica next to other Git-backed editors.
lead: Mica is a small content editor for static Astro websites. It keeps structured content in Git, uses Astro's Content Collections, and needs no database and no CMS on the published website. Here is how it compares with six other editors, and when one of them is the better choice.
statusNote: Mica is experimental and not ready for production. It has no roles, no approval steps and no page builder.

guide.title: Choose Mica
guide.text: You build with Astro and want content as plain files in Git, single-language or multilingual, a local or self-hosted editor, a live preview of the real page, and agents through MCP, with no database.

guide.title: Choose a hosted CMS
guide.text: Managed infrastructure, support, roles or approval steps matter more to you than an editor that you run yourself.

guide.title: Choose another Git editor
guide.text: Its Git hosts, localization, editing experience or way to integrate fit your project better.

changeNote: These products change often. Read their documentation before you decide.

rows.label: Content in Git, and which hosts
rows.mica: Yes. Plain Git, no host API. Tested in CI: Forgejo. In use with github.com and gitlab.com. The self-hosted editor pushes over HTTPS.

rows.label: Hosted service, self-hosting
rows.mica: No hosted service. A local editor, or a container that you run.

rows.label: Database or index
rows.mica: None, for the editor and for the website.

rows.label: Astro support
rows.mica: Official package. Content reaches Astro as Content Collections, with types.

rows.label: Sign-in for editors
rows.mica: Local: none, only on your machine. Self-hosted: any OpenID Connect provider.

rows.label: Save and publish
rows.mica: A save writes a draft. Publish makes one commit of the changes the editor chooses.

rows.label: Preview and visual editing
rows.mica: The real Astro page beside the form, with the drafts. A click moves the cursor to the field. Self-hosted: with an optional preview container. No editing on the page.

rows.label: External data (products, places, codes)
rows.mica: Yes. Entries link to items of a JSON or CSV file that Mica does not edit.

rows.label: Map field
rows.mica: Yes. It stores latitude, longitude and zoom.

rows.label: Localization (i18n)
rows.mica: Yes. A field has a value for each language in one entry, with fallbacks. The editor shows one language at a time, and the preview follows it. No machine translation.

rows.label: Roles and review
rows.mica: No roles. Review with a staging branch and a second Mica.

rows.label: AI agents
rows.mica: MCP server built in, local and self-hosted. Agents save drafts. Publishing by an agent is off by default.
